title: Are peptides the real future of longevity?
excerpt: The same social media that turned people against vaccines is now selling unapproved injections as the secret to a better version of yourself. Four viral peptides, four times the same question: do you know the science behind it?
author: The Assay
seoTitle: Are peptides the real future of longevity?
seoDescription: A look at BPC-157, GHK-Cu, collagen peptides, and CJC-1295 plus ipamorelin: what the research actually shows, what we still do not know, and why FDA status matters.
